styleLock.direction: warm umber low-key dried-goods detail-page commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: one flat plane per screen: a dark umber field #241C15 laid over open-grain walnut board #4A3527 for the hero, macro, scene and gallery screens, alternating with a wheat-gold paper band #E8D5A2 carrying a wavy die-cut lower edge for the icon, spec and closing screens, and an off-white card field #F7F2E8 for the packshot, comparison and section-detail screens; no gradient, no marble, no pure seamless studio sweep, no landscape scenery
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm single-side soft key between 3000K and 4000K, deep matte falloff on the dark screens and a broad bounce fill on the paper screens, low contrast with fibrous dry highlights only, one defined contact shadow that always grounds the product, never a hard flash, never a flat shadowless beauty look, never a glossy plastic sheen
styleLock.surfaceSystem: walnut board #4A3527 with visible open grain, folded indigo linen cloth #2B3348, pale glazed ceramic bowl and shallow dish #F3EBDC with a hairline rim, amber cooking liquor #C8912F, wheat-gold paper card #E8D5A2, off-white card board #F7F2E8, dark umber matte board #241C15
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif used only for headline and label placeholders; wheat-gold #E8D5A2 or off-white #F7F2E8 lettering on the dark umber field #241C15, brick-red #9E2F22 or dark umber #241C15 lettering on the paper fields #E8D5A2 and #F7F2E8; headline 28-48pt, one sub-line 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, one weight per screen; every label sits inside an outlined chip or a dotted circle; no calligraphy, no brush script, no serif display, no vertical letter columns
styleLock.iconSystem: hollow thin-line pictograms at one uniform stroke weight, three per screen maximum, drawn in brick-red #9E2F22 on the wheat-gold band #E8D5A2 and in wheat-gold #E8D5A2 on the dark umber field #241C15, each icon centred above its own empty dotted caption circle; no 3D icons, no gradient fills, no flames, crosses, shields or body diagrams
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 20-degree attitude and constant scale for the dish and pieces across the set; dried pieces always read matte, brittle and fibrous with a dry textured cap and a pale dry stem, cooked pieces read plump with real relief in clear amber liquor; every item grounded by a contact shadow; nothing bleached, glossy, wet-looking or recoloured; text overlays never cross a piece
noDrift: no mixed fonts or brush calligraphy
no pure white seamless studio sweep, no marble, no gradient field
no glossy plastic sheen or wet look on the dried pieces
no visible brand mark, QR code, membership badge or contact detail
no printed origin name, grade, weight, count, content figure, test result or efficacy wording
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm umber low-key dried-goods ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a dark umber field #241C15, a wheat-gold paper band #E8D5A2, an off-white card field #F7F2E8 and one brick-red accent #9E2F22; warm tone throughout; warm single-side soft key between 3000K and 4000K with deep matte falloff on dark screens and a broad bounce fill on paper screens, fibrous matte highlights only, one defined contact shadow that always grounds the product; one flat plane per screen, a wavy die-cut edge where the paper band meets the field below, no gradient, no marble, no pure seamless studio white, no scenery; one modern geometric sans-serif for headline and label placeholders only, hollow thin-line pictograms at one uniform stroke weight inside empty dotted caption circles, three per screen maximum; dried pieces read matte, brittle and fibrous, cooked pieces read plump in clear amber liquor, never glossy, never plastic; stable slight 3/4 20-degree product attitude and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts or brush calligraphy, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

【逐屏事实】panel-01 深棕近黑背景上一只浅釉碗盛琥珀色菌汤，汤面浮油花与两枚泡发菌体，碗下是木砧板与蓝粗布，左侧虚化一把木勺，上方金色两行大标题写产地加晒干与山珍话术，并附胶囊形小标与一条红色六边形缎带副条，底部刚露出三枚图标的顶缘。panel-02 麦金色纸带上排三枚细线圆形图标（生长、采摘、营养三类），下接波浪撕口转入深底，金色大标题加两行正文，正文直接比较不同品种菌体的蛋白质、碳水化合物、脂类与矿物质高低，下半重复 panel-01 的汤碗。panel-03 麦金底黑字大标题加红色缎带副条，其下 45 度高角度俯拍同一汤碗，碗底叠半透明白卡起一张四栏表的表头（蛋白质、脂肪、糖类、有机酸）。panel-04 上半续完该表的每 100 克数值（四栏各一个带 G 的数字）与一行白卡补充成分句，波浪撕口转入深橄榄底，金色两行标题写品种与高原产区，下半是两株土中鲜菇的极低角度浅景深微距。panel-05 鲜菇微距上沿叠三枚砖红圆角标签（风土、日照雨水、山林环境三类承诺），下接深底金色两行标题与两行正文（无肥无药一类种植承诺），再一镜鲜菇微距。panel-06 两镜鲜菇微距之间夹一条麦金卡带，带上是红色引号式两行标题（人工采摘、新鲜健康）。panel-07 麦金描框的鲜菇微距，转米白底黑字两行对仗标题（野生鲜味、云南风味）加一条红色缎带副条。panel-08 鲜菇微距下缘压一枚砖红梅花形印章字样，米白底一行正文加一条虚线，下方再入一镜鲜菇微距。panel-09 与 panel-08 构图与字样近乎重复。panel-10 先重复 panel-08 段落，再转入麦色底黑字两行做法标题与红色缎带副条，下方并列两张同一汤碗。panel-11 2x2 四格同一汤碗图库，每格下压一枚米白胶囊标签写同一道菜名，左下叠黑底促销贴片（入会免单字样）并附二维码。
【品类判定依据（以图为准，不随文件夹名）】商品本体是干燥整只菌菇干货：panel-01 标题即写晒干，干货呈哑光脆断状态，panel-04 至 panel-09 的鲜菇画面只承担风土叙事而非商品形态，全部成品画面（panel-01、03、10、11）无一例外是炖煮后的汤碗，即先泡发再炖汤的烹饪食材。故取 L1「生鲜粮油」/ L2「粮油」（干货杂粮归粮油米面），leaf「干制羊肚菌煲汤菌菇」，productFamily 取 food。改判理由：文件夹名为「食品」，但页面既无开袋即食的零食包装与食用画面（排除 食品饮料/休闲零食），也无粉剂、菌汤包或杯装冲泡步骤（排除 食品饮料/冲调），无即饮液体（排除 饮料），商品非鲜品亦非净菜半成品（排除 生鲜粮油/水果、半成品、调味），更非胶囊、粉剂或孢子粉一类滋补构件（排除 医药保健/营养补充），因此与文件夹名不一致时按图重判为生鲜粮油。
【已剥离内容（零容忍）】原品牌与店铺字号、水印与会员促销贴片、panel-11 的二维码与入会免单字样、梅花形印章字样、三枚风土标签原词、红色缎带副条原句、全部大标题与正文原句、四格菜名胶囊标签原句；同时不写死任何事实：产地与产区名与山野野生表述、品种与等级与规格比较（含品种间蛋白质高低排序、大小厚薄分级）、每 100 克营养成分表的全部数值与补充成分句、泡发比例与时长、净含量与只数、种植承诺（无肥无药、环境洁净一类）、采摘方式与新鲜健康与鲜香味美与山珍等级等口感与功效暗示（增强免疫、抗氧化、安神一类一律不作为事实）、检测与认证与溯源、保质期与储存期、销量与好评数；以上全部改为 「{selling_point_n}」/「{callout_n}」 占位或空白 proof placeholder（空印章双环框、空矩形凭证框、空参数行与空表单元格、空胶囊标签、空按钮位）。可信度只由可见质地承担：菌盖起伏纹理与干度哑光、折断菌柄的断面与空腔、干燥件与泡发件同器同光双栏、汤面琥珀色泽。另新增一镜源图没有的无字干燥阵列主图（shot-02）以补平台白底方图位，其余分镜角色与源页面一一对应。
